notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence: mainly Lighthouse Friends (Journal of the House of Assembly cited there, not read), Parks Canada and CRHP texts. The Marine annual reports in the corpus start 1900 and cover Ontario, not pre-1949 Newfoundland. Disagreements: focal height 331 ft (Parks Canada) vs 335 ft (LF); Wikipedia lists William Freeman 1913-1932? (not in LF, leads only, not used); Jack May end 2003 (LF) vs 2004 (Wikipedia). Roster years from LF's keeper list; the 1929 concrete casing date is given by Parks as 1929 (year of the earthquake) but LF says 'subsequently'. The 2014 heritage-lighthouse designation date in our record is not source-checked here. Roster dates for Barry Porter's other stations (Bacalhao 1988-92, Surgeon's Cove 1992-2002) are derived from 'four years' and 'ten years until 2002' in the podcast notes.
